name: Vectors and Matrices
description: Treat vectors as portfolios and matrices as transformations of space.

lessonNames.l4-portfolio-return: Portfolio return as a dot product
lessonNames.l5-acting-on-a-vector: A matrix acting on a vector

lessonObjectives.l1-mixing: Form linear combinations and see which points they reach.
lessonObjectives.l2-lining-up: Compute a dot product and read it as how well two vectors line up.
lessonObjectives.l3-lengths-angles: Find lengths and angles with the dot product.
lessonObjectives.l4-portfolio-return: Compute a portfolio’s return as its weights dotted with asset returns.
lessonObjectives.l5-acting-on-a-vector: Multiply a matrix by a vector as a combination of its columns.
lessonObjectives.l6-moving-the-plane: Recognise rotations, stretches and shears from their matrices.
lessonObjectives.l7-one-after-another: Multiply matrices and see why the order matters.
lessonObjectives.l8-identity-transpose: Use the identity matrix and the transpose, including $(AB)^T = B^T A^T$.
lessonObjectives.l9-one-matrix-equation: Write a system of linear equations as $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$.
lessonObjectives.l10-undoing: Find a $2 \times 2$ inverse and use it to solve a system.
lessonObjectives.l11-no-inverse: Recognise a singular matrix by the way it squashes the plane.
lessonObjectives.l12-numpy-matrices: Build, multiply and invert matrices in NumPy, and prefer solving to inverting.
